description: Load a React DevTools Profiler JSON export. This is the entry point for the manual profiling path: open React DevTools in the browser → Profiler tab → Record → interact → Stop → Export JSON → share the file path here. Returns a profileId for use with get_render_summary, get_slow_components, get_rerender_causes, and the other analysis tools.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the exported React Profiler JSON file
